changelog:
- Major update: Replaced the "create-ticket" skill with the new "check_transaction" skill for AOX.
- The skill now allows users to check the status of blockchain transactions by submitting a TxId.
- Integrates with the AOX transaction API for real-time queries and human-readable results.
- Removed all previous code and documentation related to Discord ticket creation.
summary: Allows users to check the status of a blockchain transaction by submitting a TxId. Queries the AOX transaction API and returns human-readable results.
